d1_sentence: The learner holds the acquired samples fixed while zero padding changes the sampled peak estimate, then holds the 1 Hz display grid fixed while acquired duration changes phase-stable two-tone resolution.

implementation.client_boundary: use client is the first statement; the default export has no required props
implementation.initial_state: Padded pair: N=64, Q=16, L=1024, phi=0; dense 1 Hz coordinates show one qualifying peak and the stable-pair target fails
implementation.performance: 150 worst-band spectra completed in 330.2 ms locally, approximately 2.2 ms for the three spectra needed by one pair-state render

results: PASS single N=64,Q=1: f_hat=176 Hz, e_bin=0.1875
PASS single N=64,Q=2: f_hat=176 Hz, e_bin=0.1875
PASS single N=64,Q=4: f_hat=172 Hz, e_bin=0.0625 and first allowed pass
PASS single N=64,Q=16: f_hat=173 Hz, e_bin=0
PASS pair N=64,Q=16: phase-0 peak 171 Hz; phase-90 peaks include 166 and 187 Hz; stability fails
PASS pair N=128,Q=16: phase-0 candidates include 169.5 and 180.5 Hz; phase-90 has one qualifying central peak at 171 Hz; stability fails
PASS pair N=256,Q=4: both phases include 170 and 180 Hz and satisfy the valley rule
PASS control: both pair presets L=1024 and grid=1 Hz; durations 62.5/250 ms; main-lobe widths 32/8 Hz
PASS every N/Q/mode/phase endpoint produces finite coordinates and amplitudes
deterministic_checks.candidate_note: The contract permits additional qualifying sidelobe maxima; resolution is decided by required near-tone candidates plus a lower intervening sample, not by requiring exactly two candidates globally.

checklist.D1_objective: PASS: padding interpolation and phase-stable duration threshold are controlled separately
checklist.D2_feedback: PASS: synchronous fixed-band calculation, no effects, async work, network, or transition delay
checklist.D3_alive_on_arrival: PASS: initial padded pair visibly fails despite a dense grid
checklist.D3_presets: PASS: four contract-named scenario presets and two keyboard-reachable phase anchors
checklist.D4_guided_task: PASS: Q=4 hits the interpolation target; padded pair fails; long pair passes at the same grid
checklist.D5_self_contained: PASS: one 134-line client file, no new dependency, existing UI kit only
checklist.accessible_and_kit_composed: PASS: native kit buttons/ranges have 44 px minimum targets, aria-valuetext, two polite live regions, and a dynamic SVG label
checklist.theme_safe: PASS by static inspection: Panel theme tokens, currentColor text/strokes, and house amber/blue only; no fixed light background or black text
checklist.honest_ranges: PASS: exhaustive endpoint harness found no NaN, infinity, or empty band
